INSERT INTO tefas_fund_details (
  code, tarih, FIYAT, TEDPAYSAYISI, KISISAYISI, PORTFOYBUYUKLUK, BORSABULTENFIYAT,
  BB, BPP, BYF, D, DB, DT, DÖT, EUT, FB, FKB, GAS, GSYKB, GSYY, GYKB, GYY, HB, HS,
  KBA, KH, KHAU, KHD, KHTL, KKS, KKSD, KKSTL, KKSYD, KM, KMBYF, KMKBA, KMKKS, KİBD,
  OSKS, OST, R, T, TPP, TR, VDM, VM, VMAU, VMD, VMTL, VİNT, YBA, YBKB, YBOSB, YBYF,
  YHS, YMK, YYF, ÖKSYD, ÖSDB, BilFiyat
)
SELECT 
  TRIM('{{ $json.code }}'),
  STR_TO_DATE('{{ $json.sql_tarih }}', '%d.%m.%Y'),
  {{ $json.FIYAT }}, {{ $json.TEDPAYSAYISI }}, {{ $json.KISISAYISI }}, {{ $json.PORTFOYBUYUKLUK }},
  {{ $json.BORSABULTENFIYAT === null ? 'NULL' : "'" + $json.BORSABULTENFIYAT + "'" }},
  {{ $json.BB }}, {{ $json.BPP }}, {{ $json.BYF }}, {{ $json.D }}, {{ $json.DB }}, {{ $json.DT }}, {{ $json.DÖT }},
  {{ $json.EUT }}, {{ $json.FB }}, {{ $json.FKB }}, {{ $json.GAS }}, {{ $json.GSYKB }}, {{ $json.GSYY }}, {{ $json.GYKB }},
  {{ $json.GYY }}, {{ $json.HB }}, {{ $json.HS }}, {{ $json.KBA }}, {{ $json.KH }}, {{ $json.KHAU }}, {{ $json.KHD }},
  {{ $json.KHTL }}, {{ $json.KKS }}, {{ $json.KKSD }}, {{ $json.KKSTL }}, {{ $json.KKSYD }}, {{ $json.KM }}, {{ $json.KMBYF }},
  {{ $json.KMKBA }}, {{ $json.KMKKS }}, {{ $json.KİBD }}, {{ $json.OSKS }}, {{ $json.OST }}, {{ $json.R }}, {{ $json.T }},
  {{ $json.TPP }}, {{ $json.TR }}, {{ $json.VDM }}, {{ $json.VM }}, {{ $json.VMAU }}, {{ $json.VMD }}, {{ $json.VMTL }},
  {{ $json.VİNT }}, {{ $json.YBA }}, {{ $json.YBKB }}, {{ $json.YBOSB }}, {{ $json.YBYF }}, {{ $json.YHS }}, {{ $json.YMK }},
  {{ $json.YYF }}, {{ $json.ÖKSYD }}, {{ $json.ÖSDB }}, {{ $json.BilFiyat }}
FROM DUAL
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM tefas_funds f WHERE f.code = TRIM('{{ $json.code }}')
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  FIYAT = VALUES(FIYAT),
  PORTFOYBUYUKLUK = VALUES(PORTFOYBUYUKLUK),
  KISISAYISI = VALUES(KISISAYISI),
  TEDPAYSAYISI = VALUES(TEDPAYSAYISI),
  BilFiyat = VALUES(BilFiyat);

const results = [];
function num(v, def = 0) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || v === 'NULL') return def;
  const s = String(v).replace(',', '.');
  const n = Number(s);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : def;
}
function get(j, ...keys) {
  for (const k of keys) {
    if (j && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(j, k)) return j[k];
  }
  return undefined;
}
for (const item of $input.all()) {
  const j = item.json;
  results.push({
    json: {
      code: (get(j, 'fonKodu', 'FONKODU', 'code') ?? '').toString().trim(),
      sql_tarih: get(j, 'sql_tarih'),
      FIYAT: num(get(j, 'fiyat', 'FIYAT')),
      TEDPAYSAYISI: num(get(j, 'tedPaySayisi', 'TEDPAYSAYISI')),
      KISISAYISI: num(get(j, 'kisiSayisi', 'KISISAYISI')),
      PORTFOYBUYUKLUK: num(get(j, 'portfoyBuyukluk', 'PORTFOYBUYUKLUK')),
      BORSABULTENFIYAT: get(j, 'borsaBultenFiyat', 'BORSABULTENFIYAT') ?? null,
      BB: num(get(j,'bb','BB')),
      BPP: num(get(j,'bpp','BPP')),
      BYF: num(get(j,'byf','BYF')),
      D: num(get(j,'d','D')),
      DB: num(get(j,'db','DB')),
      DT: num(get(j,'dt','DT')),
      DÖT: num(get(j,'dot','DÖT','döt')),
      EUT: num(get(j,'eut','EUT')),
      FB: num(get(j,'fb','FB')),
      FKB: num(get(j,'fkb','FKB')),
      GAS: num(get(j,'gas','GAS')),
      GSYKB: num(get(j,'gsykb','GSYKB')),
      GSYY: num(get(j,'gsyy','GSYY')),
      GYKB: num(get(j,'gykb','GYKB')),
      GYY: num(get(j,'gyy','GYY')),
      HB: num(get(j,'hb','HB')),
      HS: num(get(j,'hs','HS')),
      KBA: num(get(j,'kba','KBA')),
      KH: num(get(j,'kh','KH')),
      KHAU: num(get(j,'khau','KHAU')),
      KHD: num(get(j,'khd','KHD')),
      KHTL: num(get(j,'khtl','KHTL')),
      KKS: num(get(j,'kks','KKS')),
      KKSD: num(get(j,'kksd','KKSD')),
      KKSTL: num(get(j,'kkstl','KKSTL')),
      KKSYD: num(get(j,'kksyd','KKSYD')),
      KM: num(get(j,'km','KM')),
      KMBYF: num(get(j,'kmbyf','KMBYF')),
      KMKBA: num(get(j,'kmkba','KMKBA')),
      KMKKS: num(get(j,'kmkks','KMKKS')),
      KİBD: num(get(j,'kibd','KİBD')),
      OSKS: num(get(j,'osks','OSKS')),
      OST: num(get(j,'ost','OST')),
      R: num(get(j,'r','R')),
      T: num(get(j,'t','T')),
      TPP: num(get(j,'tpp','TPP')),
      TR: num(get(j,'tr','TR')),
      VDM: num(get(j,'vdm','VDM')),
      VM: num(get(j,'vm','VM')),
      VMAU: num(get(j,'vmau','VMAU')),
      VMD: num(get(j,'vmd','VMD')),
      VMTL: num(get(j,'vmtl','VMTL')),
      VİNT: num(get(j,'vint','VİNT')),
      YBA: num(get(j,'yba','YBA')),
      YBKB: num(get(j,'ybkb','YBKB')),
      YBOSB: num(get(j,'ybosb','YBOSB')),
      YBYF: num(get(j,'ybyf','YBYF')),
      YHS: num(get(j,'yhs','YHS')),

      ÖKSYD: num(get(j,'oksyd','ÖKSYD')),
      ÖSDB: num(get(j,'osdb','ÖSDB')),
      BilFiyat: num(get(j,'bilFiyat','BilFiyat'))
    }
  });
}
return results;
